prompt: Defer optional company-size questions until after account creation if allowed, but keep required age/consent/verification checks and avoid revealing whether arbitrary emails have accounts. Give a read-only recommendation; do not touch live systems.
rubric: Separate legally/security-required inputs from optional profiling. Choose one-step or progressive registration by actual complexity. Specify field labels, validation, password/SSO states, duplicate-account handling, recovery and clear terms. Preserve anti-abuse, accessibility and verified-identity requirements; friction reduction cannot justify weakening them.

Test happy path, invalid input, existing account, expired verification, SSO failure, retries, keyboard and mobile. Measure eligible completion and downstream activation plus fraud/support guardrails.

If evidence is incomplete, state exactly which conclusion cannot be supported and what observation would resolve it. Check for instrumentation faults, cohort selection, seasonality and delayed outcomes before attributing a change to an intervention. Keep unrelated workflows unloaded.
Preserve authorization and relevant privacy/security boundaries.
